en: O lotus-eyed Rāma, clad in golden garments and adorned with armor; O Rāma, wielding the bow;
O Rāma, the destroyer of impurities, the bestower of desired boons!
In secret, I bow to you, Sītā, Rāma, and Lakṣmaṇa. || 1 ||

O Rāma, you who wear crocodile-shaped earrings; O Rāma, you who are served by crowns; O Rāma, you who wear jeweled diadems; O Rāma, you who speak so sweetly; O Rāma, you who are born of the lineage of Manu; O Rāma, you who are the best among men.
In secret, I bow to you two, Sītā, Rāma, and Lakṣmaṇa.
O Rāma, you two are perfected in truth; O Rāma, you two are terrifying in battle and protectors of all; O Rāma, you two are adorned with every ornament;
O Rāma, you two possess truthful minds and nourish all beings.
In secret, I bow to you two, Sītā, Rāma, and Lakṣmaṇa.
O Rāma, you two who wear crests of matted hair, protectors of the distressed;
O Rāma, you two who uphold the Himalayas, possessed of divine forms;
O Rāma, you two who are worshipped in manifold ways, endowed with a pair of long arms.
In secret, I bow to you two, Sītā, Rāma, and Lakṣmaṇa.

O Rāma, you whose knees touch the earth; O Rāma, you who travel on foot; O Rāma, you whose broad arrows are like the rays of the sun; O Rāma, you whose feet destroy all sin; O Rāma, you who are supremely sattvic; O Rāma, you who are affectionate toward your devotees.
In secret, I bow to you two, Sītā, Rāma, and Lakṣmaṇa. || 5 ||
O Rāma, you who dwell in the forest, clad in bark garments;
O Rāma, you who subsist on forest fruits; O Rāma, you who are worshipped by Indra;
O Rāma, you who are a mine of excellent virtues; O Rāma, you who crushed Vālin.
In secret, I bow to you two, Sītā, Rāma, and Lakṣmaṇa.
O Rāma, sons of Daśaratha; O Rāma, beloved of Paśupati;
O Rāma, dwellers on the moon; O Rāma, you whose minds are pure;
O Rāma, destroyers of the ten-faced one with sharpened arrows.
In secret, I bow to you two, Sītā, Rāma, and Lakṣmaṇa.
O Rāma, you two have lotus-like eyes and are experts in battle;
O Rāma, you two possess formidable forms and are as beautiful as the god of love;
O Rāma, you two are adorned with garlands and wear golden anklets.
In secret, I bow to you two, Sītā, Rāma, and Lakṣmaṇa.
O Rāma, served by Bharata; O Rāma, who liberates from misfortune;
O Rāma, holding arrows in hand; O Rāma, praised by the Boar;
O Rāma, bearing a quiver; O Rāma, clad in firm armor.
In secret, I bow to you two, Sītā, Rāma, and Lakṣmaṇa.
O Rāma, you two are practitioners of Dharma, witnesses to all actions, intent upon the path of righteousness, O Rāma, bestowers of peace;
adorned by Dharma, O Rāma, you rejoice in your deeds.
In secret, I bow to you two, Sītā, Rāma, and Lakṣmaṇa. || 10 ||
O Rāma, you two with dark-blue bodies and swaying earrings;
O Rāma, you two who terrify Death and crush Vālin;
O Rāma, you two who remove all impurity and wear graceful ornaments.
In secret, I bow to you two, Sītā, Rāma, and Lakṣmaṇa. || 11 ||
O Rāma, you are the delight of your mothers, Bala and Subala; O Rāma, you are honored by your brothers as the destroyers of their enemies;
O Rāma, you are the crest-jewels of your brothers and the lords of the bridge.
In secret, I bow to you two, Sītā, Rāma, and Lakṣmaṇa.
O Rāma, you who possess arrows as your bonds; O Rāma, you who have crushed the Dānavas;
O Rāma, you who increase your lineage; O Rāma, you who are resplendent with strength;
O Rāma, you who are victorious over the pride of the wicked; O Rāma, you who are resplendent with strength.
In secret, I bow to you two, Sītā, Rāma, and Lakṣmaṇa. || 13 ||
O Rāma, you two possess the marks of royalty and desire victory;
O Rāma, you two are mounted upon excellent elephants and are honored by the immortals;
O Rāma, you two have conquered envy and have subdued your enemies.
In secret, I bow to you two, Sītā, Rāma, and Lakṣmaṇa.
O Rāma, you are honored by all; O Rāma, you perform all actions; O Rāma, you are the destroyers of pride; O Rāma, you are free from all modifications;
O Rāma, you are difficult to describe; O Rāma, you are the illuminators of all.
In secret, I bow to you two, Sītā, Rāma, and Lakṣmaṇa. || 15 ||
O Rāma, you two born of the solar dynasty, destroyers of worldly existence,
resting upon the golden throne, the very sheaths for Rāma’s feet;
O Rāma, beloved of the Sun’s son, you who are praised by poets.
In secret, I bow to you two, Sītā, Rāma, and Lakṣmaṇa. || 16 ||
Rāma Rāghava Sītā, Rāma Rāghava,
Rāma Rāghava Sītā, Rāma Rāghava; Kṛṣṇa Keśava Rādhā, Kṛṣṇa Keśava.
O Kṛṣṇakeśava, O Rādhā, O Kṛṣṇakeśava! || 17 ||
Sītārāma, Sītārāma, Sītārāma, Sītārāma, Sītārāma, Sītārāma, Sītārāma,
Sītārāma; Sītārāma, Sītārāma, Sītārāma, Sītārāma.
Sītārāma, Sītārāma, Sītārāma, Sītārāma. || 18 ||
